identitySignals: Agenda gives 'Sonic' in Santa Rosa, CA; Sonic (sonic.com, formerly Sonic.net) is an internet service provider headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA (Wikipedia; Sonic's own bid document says 'Sonic is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA')

Sonic's 2021 bid response to Santa Rosa City Schools lists Oakland Unified School District as a client, with 10Gbps wide-area network (WAN) services to 96 sites and dark fiber WAN services to 4 sites, matching OUSD's 'Dark Fiber Lease Agreement' and 'Wide-Area Network' agreements
Sonic's website has an E-Rate schools and libraries page offering managed dark fiber WAN, matching OUSD's Category 1 E-Rate WAN contracts with Sonic
research.notes: Legal entity left null: public sources show related names (Sonic.net, LLC per Wikipedia; Sonic Telecom, LLC per FCC and directory listings) and I could not confirm the contracting entity in a registry. Registry IDs (CA SOS, SAM.gov UEI) not retrieved. Street address (2260 Apollo Way, Santa Rosa) appears in directory listings but was not confirmed on an official page I could fetch, so omitted. sonic.com lists erate@sonic.net only as an E-Rate-specific contact, so no general email was used.

profile.summary: Sonic is an internet service provider based in Santa Rosa, California. It offers fiber-optic internet, phone and TV service to homes and businesses. It also sells managed dark fiber and lit fiber wide-area network services to schools and libraries through the federal E-Rate program.

sources.title: E-Rate Program - Service Provider - Sonic Internet

review.notes: Sonic of Santa Rosa, CA is an ISP selling managed dark fiber and lit fiber WAN services to schools via E-Rate (sonic.com/schools-and-libraries), matching OUSD's dark fiber, WAN and E-Rate Category 1 agreements. Summary, website, phone, headquarters and orgType are supported by the cited sites; the summary is neutral.
